e2e.//: RESOURCE-CONSUMING lane. Deliberately NOT part of `affected` and NOT referenced by any target's dependsOn or by targetDefaults — it runs ONLY on an explicit `nx run apigen-engine-runtime:e2e` (nx affected never selects it). It runs the sibling *.e2e.ts suites via vitest.e2e.config.ts. `dependsOn: []` is correct here: both suites drive only the system `git` binary and a real `node:http` server over source (`./parity-harness`) — neither needs this package's built artifact.
